image_description: An underwater photograph of a scuba diver swimming near the sandy seabed. The diver is wearing a black wetsuit, a red and white buoyancy control device (BCD), and full scuba gear including a tank, regulator, and mask. Bubbles are visible rising from the regulator area. The lighting is diffuse and blue-green, typical of underwater environments.
